why: EXHAUSTED for code-harvest: 700/2200 sitemap group pages processed in wave_20261101 (indices 0-299, 300-599, 2100-2199). Of 535 live-looking listings, ~95% of extracted 22-char codes were already in the dedupe union (groups.json + .existing_codes.json + wave_20261031); every one of the ~40 fresh codes returned EMPTY og:title (dead) on the mandatory curl check. Fresh-code yield is near zero and the remainder are dead. TECHNICAL NOTE: server-side pipeline works without a live browser - group page onclick contains window.location.href='/verify/<slug>', and the verify page HTML embeds a real chat.whatsapp.com/<22-char> code. Revoked groups show a disabled 'Invite Link No Longer Active' button with no verify URL. Category parse from breadcrumb/pill '/category/<slug>', country from first flagcdn flag, group image from pps.whatsapp.net img whose alt contains the group name. RESUME POINT: unprocessed sitemap indices 600-2099 and 2200 (state lost - /tmp cleared between runs; re-dedupe needed).
